decisive_spans.text: Serum dengue NS1 antigen was positive

response.rationale: D5 (Dengue Encephalitis) is strongly supported by the positive dengue NS1 antigen and the neurological symptoms and MRI findings. The MRI findings, while unusual, are presented as part of the dengue encephalitis support. D9 (Brainstem Encephalitis) is also strongly supported by the neurological symptoms and MRI findings, but the positive dengue NS1 antigen directly points to dengue as the cause of the encephalitis, making D5 a more specific and likely diagnosis. The other candidates are either contradicted by the positive dengue NS1 antigen (D10, D9, D6) or less comprehensively supported.
